summary: Ashland Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment and restatement of its existing European accounts receivable securitization program. On September 24, 2026, Ashland International Receivables DAC, as seller, with Ashland and subsidiaries as originators, amended the Receivables Purchase Agreement and Master Framework Agreement originally dated October 19, 2023, extending the scheduled termination date to September 21, 2029, while maintaining the €125 million facility limit; Bank of America assigned its committed purchaser role to Bank of America Europe DAC. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation.
